treatment.name: LASER Dental Treatments
treatment.overview: Dental lasers enable precise, minimally invasive procedures with improved comfort and faster healing.

types.name: Laser Gum Contouring / Gingivectomy
description: Reshapes excess gum tissue for a balanced smile.

types.name: Frenectomy (Tongue/Lip Tie)
description: Releases restrictive frenum to improve function.

types.name: Laser Whitening Assist
description: Enhances whitening gel activation for faster results.

types.name: Laser Disinfection in RCT/Periodontal Pockets
description: Adjunctive bacterial reduction for better outcomes.

cost.note: Fees depend on indication, area treated, and session count.

before: Clinical evaluation and suitability for laser approach.
Procedure plan and estimated sessions explained.
after: Mild tenderness possible; usually quick recovery.
Specific hygiene instructions for treated site.

avoid: Very hot/spicy foods immediately after soft-tissue procedures
prefer: Soft, lukewarm foods for 24 hours if tissue was treated
foodGuidelines.tip: Follow prescribed mouthwash and avoid vigorous brushing over treated gums initially.

pros: Avoids procedural costs if symptoms are mild
cons: Persistent gum excess, tethered tissues, or bacterial load
Slower/less comfortable healing with conventional methods in some cases
prosConsOfSkipping.summary: Lasers can make many procedures gentler and recovery faster when clinically appropriate.

faq.a: Yes—dental lasers are FDA-approved and safe when used with proper protocols.
Usually minimal bleeding due to laser coagulation; most patients report high comfort.
